c: While Boogaloo of Illusions (XVIII) is active, overall

continuously changes between -25% and +25% over 10 second intervals. The player also gains +1% Area each time they level up. The oscillation is done by applying a multiplier on top of everything else ranging from 0.75 to 1.25, which on average, will give an overall net neutral Area bonus.
The Arcana only starts giving stat boosts when the player selects it and does not give extra stats retroactively. If the stats are desirable, select the Arcana early.
